data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 (Einkommensteuerbescheid)
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielau assessed Johanna Beispielacker's income tax for 2025 based on her tax return, dated 19 November 2026. The assessed tax is €2,377.00 against €2,916.00 already withheld, resulting in a refund (Guthaben) of €539.00 to be transferred to her account.
data.explanation: This is your official 2025 income tax assessment. The tax office calculated €2,377.00 in tax, which is less than the €2,916.00 already withheld from your salary, so you receive a refund of €539.00 paid automatically to your account — no action needed for that. The childcare costs for your son were only recognised at two-thirds as special expenses (Sonderausgaben). If you disagree with any part of the calculation, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Beispielau; the app shows until when you can do this. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, the assessment becomes final and binding.
